card.name: Word after "should" or "should be"
card.fires_on: The word right after "should" or "should be" that completes a hopeful expectation, such as able, okay, help, improve, prove or possible. Also the ending "able" in "detectable".

modes.label: able after should be
modes.description: "able" or "possible" completing "should be" in a statement of what is expected to work.
modes.example: they should be<< able>> to Summon it with ease.

modes.label: verb after should
modes.description: A verb such as help, improve or prove following "should", predicting a good outcome.
modes.example: Awareness of this link should<< improve>> identification and early treatment of CDI.

modes.label: should itself
modes.description: The word "should" after "this" in a theory-based expectation.
modes.example: In theory, this<< should>> have removed all factors outside of breast-
